payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model incorporates wave energy and hydrodynamic conditions, which are essential for understanding wave erosion effects on coral reef development.

claims.text: The model quantifies the impact of wave energy and refraction on shoreline geometry and coral colony flourishing.
Wave parameters, including significant wave height, are incorporated into the model to approximate storm impacts on coral reef development.
The model addresses hydrodynamic boundary conditions, which include wave conditions affecting erosion processes.
